رننت (form I)
# رَنَنْتُ (ranantu) /ra.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of رَنَّ (ranna)
# رَنَنْتَ (rananta) /ra.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of رَنَّ (ranna)
# رَنَنْتِ (rananti) /ra.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of رَنَّ (ranna)
# رُنِنْتُ (runintu) /ru.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of رَنَّ (ranna)
# رُنِنْتَ (runinta) /ru
